title: Notice regarding Special Court from 29.06.2026 to 03.07.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 25/06/2026
It is hereby notified that from 29.06.2026 to 03.07.2026 ;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 25/06/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that from 29.06.2026 to 03.07.2026 ;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.Y. Kogje and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Samir J.
Dave would sit in Special Division Bench from 11:00 AM to
05:00 PM to take up the notified matter/s.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Ilesh J. Vora and
Hon’ble Mr. Justice R. T. Vachhani) would take up the matters
notified in the Cause list of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble
Mr. Justice A.Y.Kogje and Hon’ble Ms. Justice Nisha M.
Thakore.)
3. Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Vimal K. Vyas)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Samir J. Dave.)
4. Hon’ble Ms. Justice Nisha M. Thakore would sit Single
and take up the notified matters.
By Order of Hon’ble the Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
